title: Gravestone Pen – Restores Faded Text on Stone
descriptionHtml:
The inscription fades long before the stone does

Weather and years wear down the gilding, and eventually the name is barely visible. Having a stonemason fill in the text costs thousands – so many stones are left standing with text that can't be read.

Fill in the text yourself, letter by letter

A pen with oil-based, weather-resistant paint and a fine tip, made for engraved text in stone. Follow the grooves of the letters at an unhurried pace – the paint dries quickly and withstands rain and frost. A quiet task that makes a big difference the next time you visit the place.

Features

  • The name can be read again – opaque paint made for engraved stone
  • Made to stay outdoors – oil-based, weather-resistant paint that handles rain and frost
  • Easy to work carefully – fine tip that follows the grooves of the letters
  • Dry before you leave – the paint dries quickly without running
  • A shade to match the stone – gold, black, white, silver, red or blue, 20 ml per pen

Change of Mind

You have 14 days to change your mind, counted from the day you receive the item.
